## 2) R3F / Three / GSAP

**Yes — all three are in use.**

| Stack | Files |
|-------|--------|
| **R3F + drei + Three** | `C:\Portfolio\src\components\hero\RibbonScene.tsx` (`@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei`, `three`). Consumed only from `C:\Portfolio\src\components\sections\About.tsx` (dynamic import, `ssr: false`). |
| **GSAP + ScrollTrigger** | `C:\Portfolio\src\components\providers\SmoothScroll.tsx` (Lenis ↔ ScrollTrigger sync); `C:\Portfolio\src\components\sections\WhatIDo.tsx` (sticky cards); `C:\Portfolio\src\components\sections\Projects.tsx` (horizontal track). |

**Also:** `motion` (Motion) in Hero, Reveal, MobileNav, and reduced-motion checks in several sections. `@gsap/react` is in `package.json` but not imported under `src/` in this quick scan.

**`C:\Portfolio\src\lib\content.ts`** — exports `site`, `capabilities`, `techStack`, `education`, `experience`, `projects`, `quote`, etc. Imported across layout and sections (e.g. `@/lib/content` in `layout.tsx`).

## 4) Layout / nav structure

- **App shell:** `C:\Portfolio\src\app\layout.tsx` — fonts (Manrope, IBM Plex Mono), metadata from `site`, body: `SmoothScroll` → `Nav` → `<main>{children}</main>` → `Footer`.
- **Single route:** `C:\Portfolio\src\app\page.tsx` — one long home page: `Hero` → `About` → `WhatIDo` → `TechStack` → `Timeline` → `Projects` → `Quote` → `Contact` (no nested app routes found).
- **Nav:** hash anchors `#about`, `#work`, `#contact` (desktop in `Nav.tsx`; mobile in `MobileNav.tsx`). Hero also links `#work` / `#contact`. Section IDs: `#top` (Hero), `#about`, `#work` (Projects), `#contact`.
